title: v0 vs Bolt: Which AI App Builder Is Right for You in 2026?
summary: v0 vs Bolt.new — an honest comparison of features, pricing, and production readiness in 2026. Plus the third option most developers discover too late.
body_markdown: v0 has a free tier with daily generation credits. The Pro plan is $20/month for unlimited generations. However, the cost of v0 itself is only part of the picture — you still need to pay separately for a database (Supabase free tier has limits), auth (Clerk free tier caps at 10,000 MAU), and hosting (Vercel free tier has usage limits). For most production apps, the total stack cost runs $60–120/month.[Blink](https://blink.new/) includes all of these in one plan — database, auth, and hosting are not add-ons.
